title: Kissed Tender Australian Kangaroo Skewers
description: Rich and tender kangaroo skewers featuring a zesty vinaigrette dressing and a yuzu-cure, perfect for a nostalgic Australian dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to 200 degrees Celsius
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper to make the vinaigrette dressing
Add the kangaroo meat to the bowl and toss to coat with the vinaigrette dressing
Thread the marinated kangaroo meat onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 8 minutes per side, or until the kangaroo meat reaches an internal temperature of 60 degrees Celsius
Once cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes
Serve the skewers on a slate tile, garnished with fresh thyme and a side of extra vinaigrette dressing
To add the yuzu-cure, brush the skewers with a little extra yuzu juice during the last minute of grilling
